title.value: Multinational Investigation of Fracture Risk with Antidepressant Use by Class, Drug, and Indication
title.justification: The title of the paper explicitly states the focus on fracture risks associated with different classes, drugs, and indications of antidepressant use.
title.quote: Multinational Investigation of Fracture Risk with Antidepressant Use by Class, Drug, and Indication

analysis.description: This paper investigates the fracture risk associated with antidepressant use in older adults across multiple jurisdictions using a common protocol. It focuses on different classes, drugs, doses, and treatment indications of antidepressants and their impact on fracture risk.

type.justification: The study involves the collection of data from different jurisdictions and the subsequent analysis of that data to investigate fracture risk associated with antidepressant use.
type.quote: Our aim was to apply a common protocol to cohorts of older antidepressant users in multiple jurisdictions to estimate fracture risk associated with different antidepressant classes, drugs, doses, and potential treatment indications.

name.justification: The research is primarily concerned with understanding the fracture risk in populations of older adults using antidepressants, typical of epidemiology studies.
name.quote: Antidepressants increase the risk of falls and fracture in older adults.

name.justification: The study evaluates the effects and risks of drugs (antidepressants) in large populations, making it a pharmacoepidemiological study.
name.quote: Our aim was to apply a common protocol to cohorts of older antidepressant users in multiple jurisdictions to estimate fracture risk associated with different antidepressant classes, drugs, doses, and potential treatment indications.
